title: Career Roadmap · IT Support Executive
summary: An IT Support Executive helps users resolve computer, software, connectivity and peripheral problems, maintains devices and accounts, and supports reliable day-to-day IT operations.

facts.Current degree: ITI COPA / Computer Operator & Programming Assistant

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Class 10 for eligible vocational pathways; Class 12 can broaden further-study and job options.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Science with Mathematics is useful, but not mandatory for every IT support route.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Computer hardware, operating systems, networking, troubleshooting and cybersecurity basics.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Logical diagnosis, clear communication, documentation and customer service.

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Computer components, operating systems, safe handling and troubleshooting basics.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Core skills
blocks.text: Install software, configure printers, diagnose hardware issues and support users.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Advanced skills
blocks.text: Networking, user accounts, backups, permissions and basic cybersecurity.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Job preparation
blocks.text: Practice help-desk tickets, document solutions and build a troubleshooting portfolio.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Assemble and configure a PC • Create a small LAN • Prepare a system troubleshooting guide • Set up a backup and recovery demonstration.
